profile.algorithm: opfs-managed-v2 protocol; freshly provisioned exact scope only
profile.adapters: controlled memory objects + shared serial atomic metadata + non-waiting shared/exclusive locks + simulated document downloads
profile.connections: independent store connections over one test backend; not actual browser tabs
profile.metadata: synchronous callbacks; actual-abort vs lost-acknowledgement outcomes, including still-live queued work
profile.retention: default persistent owner hold, explicit idempotent holds and released tombstones
profile.file: named File wrapper + explicit shared-lock lease; no whole-file arrayBuffer in the algorithm
profile.download: prepared own lease/URL; synchronous one-shot requested/unobservable; explicit retryable disposal
profile.deletion: revision-checked selected/hold/read/identity guards; owned deleting/deleted tombstone protocol
profile.recovery: readonly original-attempt inspection; transaction publication fence; physical settlement separately evidenced
profile.resources: each scenario explicitly closes tracked connections/locks/writers/URLs/borrowed work; retained committed/quarantined objects are intentional

evidence.indeterminateLiveTransaction: logical failure does not cancel queued metadata; recovery serializes after it
evidence.physicalQuarantine: owner lock loss/invalidation cannot manufacture a persistent I/O settlement marker
evidence.twoContainerMetadata: MP4/WebM exact request/policy snapshots tested; fake bytes are not decode evidence

limitations: No native OPFS/IndexedDB/Web Locks adapter or real browser/tab/download test in this stage.
B1–B28 pass only for controlled port semantics; native-platform obligations and B30/B31 remain pending.
No real MP4/WebM encoding/decoding or audio regression evidence added; prior v1 measurements are historical only.
Controlled map snapshots/Blob bytes are test allocations, not a production metadata schema/index or memory/GC benchmark.
Already provisioned connection ownership transfers on successful open only; caller owns cleanup on rejected open.
Unknown physical I/O is quarantined; no automatic timer/force sweep, future-publication retry or rollback.
Persistent holds/outcome/tombstone history is retained; no compaction/persistent quota or storage eviction guarantee.
No hostile-origin containment, native user-folder overwrite, download completion, crash/power-loss/fsync guarantee.
No public API/factory/exports/version change, native managed-storage certification, tag/release/npm; commit/push and existing CI regressions are separate delivery steps.
next: Separately authorize native OPFS/IDB/Web Locks/document adapters and scoped real-browser MP4/WebM decode, download, cancellation, retention/deletion/recovery tests; public P27/P28 remains later.
